body: Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-16 01:36Z, my own slip). Never `cd` into a worker's named worktree from the coordinator's Bash tool: the shell's cwd persists, and later commands would then run inside that root. That can refuse a carried gate's credit (another session's command in the root) or misattribute work. For reads use `git -C <root> …`, or the Read and Grep tools with absolute paths. At 01:36Z I ran `cd .tmp/wt-train2-carry-11865 && git diff --cached …`, read-only, after train-3a's gate had already ENDed, so no run was affected. I moved back at once.
